name: Yeelight
description: Yeelight Wi-Fi bulbs and strips over the Yeelight WiFi Light Inter-Operation Specification (turn on "LAN Control" in the Yeelight app): M-SEARCH discovery on UDP 1982, JSON commands on TCP 55443, colour streamed in music mode (the light connects back to a listener on an ephemeral port) with a 1 command/s fallback; white-only lights get brightness and power. Untested: nobody working on HueDeck owns a Yeelight. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/yeelight.md.
